$comment: Module photo galleries. SOURCE OF SHAPE: client brief - each of the 7 modules has 4 activity categories, each holding an ordered list of photos. Keys are canonical module slugs from content/modules.json and category slugs from lib/modules.ts. An empty array means 'no photos yet', which is the correct state for a fresh checkout. Written by the admin panel and committed through the GitHub API; the public site reads it through lib/gallery.ts.
